Record Class BlockFinder

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.minestom.server.collision.BlockFinder
Record Components:
ray - the ray to traverse
blockIterator - the block iterator
blockGetter - the block getter, such as an Instance or Chunk
hitboxGetter - a function to get each BoundingBox from a block
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterator<Collection<Ray.Intersection<Block>>>
public record BlockFinder(Ray ray, BlockIterator blockIterator, Block.Getter blockGetter, Function<Block, Collection<BoundingBox>> hitboxGetter) extends Record implements Iterator<Collection<Ray.Intersection<Block>>>
An iterator for collisions along a Ray using certain providers for blocks and their hitboxes.

Use Ray.findBlocks(Block.Getter) to create.

Keep in mind that while the entry points are always accurate, the exit points may not be in blocks like stairs.

For these cases, you can manually check and merge, or use a BlockQueue instead.
